text:
Kira (People Ops): Quick thread for Samir (contractor-to-hire) start Mon. Hes in SF Fri night and asked if we can do a Saturday pickup at a nearby coworking (WeWork Embarcadero) instead of hotel. He also asked about pro-rated benefits eligibility and if SSN can be submitted after start.

Miko (Recruiter): Sam (candidate) prefers Saturday because flight lands late Fri. He's fine picking up at WeWork kiosk as long as package is labeled for hold-for pickup. He says passport is valid but SSN application is in progress (applied last month).

Sam (Candidate): Confirming I can pick up Sat 10am at WeWork Embarcadero. I have a valid passport and CA DL. I can upload photos now. About benefits: will I get prorated health coverage if I enroll within 30 days? Im a contractor converting so curious about eligibility timing.

Kira (People Ops): Benefits-bot will clarify but short: full-time conversions are eligible on start date; premium/proration rules depend on carrier — Benefits-bot will email Day-1 packet. For I-9 we need original docs at pickup; courier/WeWork staff can hold but a Redwood rep or approved kiosk handoff must sight originals. If SSN arrives later, payroll can update tax forms after start.

BGCheck Desk: Vendor note: Without SSN we can run ID-first checks using passport + DL; please have candidate sign consent now. Name/address history may prompt manual review but we can kick off. Uploads to secure portal accepted.

IT-bot: Shipping to WeWork accepted with exact hold-for label. Use this format:

"Hold for: Samir Patel / Redwood Inference - WeWork Pickup"
We will stage asset and require AUP signed via link before unlocking. Bring mobile for verification. VPN/profile staged until AUP ack.

Accessiblity Team: Candidate requested live-captioning for orientation and large-font handout. We can provide accessible PDF and arrange live-captioning during first-hour.

Benefits-bot: Auto-response: For transfers/conversions, benefits eligibility starts on official start date. Enrollment window = 30 days. Carrier billing/proration varies; HR will confirm carrier-specific proration in Day-1 email. You will receive benefits packet on Day 1 AM.

Kira (People Ops): Plan: 1) Miko to confirm Saturday 10am pickup, 2) Sam upload passport + DL to secure portal now and sign BG consent, 3) IT ship to WeWork with hold-for label and email AUP link, 4) People Ops rep (Kira) meet at WeWork kiosk to sight originals and complete I-9, 5) Benefits-bot send Day-1 packet on Monday morning, 6) Accessibility team to prepare materials.

Miko (Recruiter): Sam uploaded documents and signed consent. Confirmed 10am Saturday pickup. I'll add WeWork pickup details to the calendar invite and ping Kira to meet at kiosk.

IT-bot: Laptop queued for WeWork hold-for pickup. AUP email sent to Sam. Remember to verify AUP before handing over.

BGCheck Desk: Starting ID verification now; SSN pending. Will update if vendor requests additional docs.

Sam (Candidate): Thanks everyone. Ill be at WeWork 10am Sat and will bring originals just in case. Looking forward to Day 1.

Kira (People Ops): Thanks team ":thumbsup:" Closing thread once handoff + AUP done.
